name: Agentic Payments Readiness Report 2026 (v1.1) - Scoring Dataset
description: An original, reproducible benchmark of whether AI agents can pay through 13 payment and financial infrastructure providers today (Airwallex, Skyfire, Payman, Crossmint, Visa, Mastercard, Adyen, PayPal, Checkout.com, Circle, Stripe, Coinbase, Wise), scored against each provider's own official documentation across 7 dimensions: agent SDK/API, MCP server availability, agent payment protocol support, developer sandbox access, spending guardrails, payment rails, and documentation/pricing transparency.
variableMeasured: D2.2 MCP server permission scope (read-only vs money-out, and confirmation gating)
D3.4 Visa Trusted Agent Protocol / Mastercard Agent Pay support (self-described)
D4.1 Self-service developer sandbox / signup without sales contact
D5.2 Human-in-the-loop confirmation or delegated/one-time-use payment tokens
D6.1 Card rail support for agent payments
D6.2 Bank transfer/ACH rail support for agent payments
D6.3 Stablecoin/crypto rail support for agent payments
D7.1 Public accessibility of core agent documentation without login
isBasedOn: Direct reading of each provider's own official domain, documentation, and/or official GitHub organization; secondary sources used only where explicitly marked and limited to verbatim reproductions of the provider's own announcements.
creativeWorkStatus: Version 1.1, quarterly re-scoring planned; corrections log published alongside the report.
